title: SAGE: Self-Evolving Storyboard Skills via Attribution-Guided Rule Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2608.17468v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Storyboards turn screenplays into visual shot plans for automated short drama production. Professional storyboarding relies on tacit directorial expertise and remains an industrial bottleneck. Large language models can automate this step, but methods for supplying directing knowledge face three challenges: (1) Knowledge acquisition: the craft remains implicit in exemplars or must be written manually. (2) Knowledge refinement: authored knowledge is not evaluated against execution outcomes, and opaque generation prevents feedback attribution to the knowledge behind each decision. (3) Knowledge injection: injecting all knowledge exceeds usable context, while manual selection for every narrative group does not scale. We present SAGE (Skill with Attribution-Guided Evolution), a deployed framework that learns, attributes, evolves, and routes directing knowledge from expert demonstrations. translated_title: SAGE：通过归因引导的规则进化实现自我演化的故事板技能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17468v1 公告类型：新 摘要：故事板将剧本转化为视觉拍摄计划，用于自动化短剧制作。专业故事板依赖于隐性导演专业知识，并仍是工业瓶颈。大型语言模型可以自动化这一步骤，但提供导演知识的方法面临三个挑战：（1）知识获取：技艺在示例中仍是隐性的，或必须手动编写。（2）知识精炼：所编写知识未根据执行结果进行评估，且不透明的生成阻碍了将反馈归因于每个决策背后的知识。（3）知识注入：注入所有知识超出可用上下文，而为每个叙事组手动选择则无法扩展。我们提出SAGE（归因引导进化的技能），这是一个已部署的框架，能从专家演示中学习、归因、进化并路由导演知识。SAGE派生出独立于剧集内容的规则。
tldr: SAGE框架通过归因引导的规则进化，自动从专家演示中学习、精炼并路由导演知识，解决了故事板制作中知识获取、精炼和注入的三大挑战，实现了可扩展的自动化故事板技能演化。
en_tdlr: SAGE framework learns, refines, and routes directing knowledge from expert demonstrations via attribution-guided rule evolution, addressing knowledge acquisition, refinement, and injection challenges to enable scalable automated storyboard skill evolution.
